title: 第25章
content: 江南市的雨夜裹着咸腥的湿气，顺着窗缝渗入王教授的书房。老式台灯在试卷堆上投下昏黄光晕，照得“反重力引擎可行性报告”几个字泛着诡异的油光。王教授的老花镜滑到鼻尖，握着红笔的手悬在半空——笔尖正对着林宇答卷上那个突兀的公式修正，喉结上下滚动，发出干涩的吞咽声。三天前，他在科学院档案室见到陈老团队保险柜里未完成的六代机设计图时，也是这般浑身发冷。此刻试卷上的拓扑结构图，竟与记忆中那些潦草的草稿严丝合缝，连某个被红笔划掉的参数都被巧妙转化成了更优解。钢笔尖突然爆墨，暗红的墨水在“量子纠缠通讯模块”字样上晕开，宛如一道新鲜的伤口。“不可能……”王教授扯松领带，后颈的冷汗浸湿了衬衫领口。显微镜下，墨点里的纳米级蜂巢结构正在缓慢蠕动，与陈老团队最新方案的误差曲线在电脑屏幕上拉出一条几乎重叠的红线。他颤抖着按下保密电话的快捷键，拨号音却变成尖锐的蜂鸣，台灯镇纸里的微型窃听器迸出电火花，在墙面上投下扭曲的阴影。窗外惊雷炸响，雨幕中隐约浮现出林宇绘制的引擎冷却管道图。王教授猛地回头，却只看见被雨水冲刷的玻璃。当他转回身，试卷上的字迹竟开始自行重组，原本工整的汉字化作蝌蚪状的外星符号，在纸面排列成类似三星堆青铜面具的图腾。他踉跄着扶住桌沿，后腰撞到抽屉暗格，那里藏着的1964年核试验现场照片滑落出来——泛黄的相纸边角，婴儿襁褓上的基因标记与林宇的检测报告如出一辙。突然，整栋楼的电路发出兹拉声响，书房陷入黑暗。应急灯亮起的瞬间，王教授看见自己映在玻璃窗上的倒影——瞳孔里闪烁着与系统数据流相同的蓝光。他的身体不受控制地抽搐，右手握着红笔在墙上疯狂涂写，扭曲的笔迹拼凑出的，竟是林宇答卷上被系统修正过的关键公式。此刻在千里之外的国安局总部，李战少将盯着监控画面里的异常波动。王教授书房的量子信号强度突然飙升，与三天前林宇考试时的能量峰值完全吻合。“启动三级警戒。”他摘下战术目镜，镜片上残留着林宇试卷的全息投影——那些被系统优化过的参数，此刻正在他视网膜上流转，拼凑成某种超越现有认知的星际坐标。当特战队破门而入时，王教授正蜷缩在满地狼藉中，手中的红笔已经折断，鲜血混着墨水在墙上画出巨大的∞符号。他的嘴里念念有词，吐出的却是陈老保险柜密码，以及赵天雷家族企业地下实验室的量子坐标。而在城市另一头，赵天雷的父亲盯着突然黑屏的监控系统，后颈植入的纳米追踪器开始发烫——那里面储存的六代机机密数据，正在被某种未知力量格式化。陈老接到消息时，正在检查林宇答卷的镜像副本。打印机突然吐出带血的纸张，上面的字迹与王教授墙上的涂鸦如出一辙。老人颤抖着戴上防爆手套，却发现指纹锁无法识别——保险柜里的原始设计图正在发生量子态坍缩，化作漫天星尘般的光点，最终聚合成林宇答卷上那个标志性的∞符号。“第七十三次播种……”陈老的低语淹没在警报声中。地下室的暗物质检测仪疯狂报警，屏幕上的波形图竟与林宇的脑电波频率完全一致。当他望向窗外，暴雨中的城市灯光突然排列成六代机的气动外形，而林宇的试卷此刻正在国安局的保险箱里微微发烫，边缘的“∞8”页码渗出淡金色的光，仿佛某种古老文明的封印正在解除。在江南三中的监控室里，值班保安盯着突然雪花纷飞的屏幕。所有指向林宇考场的摄像头，画面都变成了三星堆青铜面具的特写，那些空洞的瞳孔里，数据流正以光速奔涌。而在赵天雷家族的私人实验室，纳米蜂巢结构的防晒霜原料开始自主组装，形成与林宇答卷上引擎完全相同的立体模型，实验室穹顶的星空投影突然扭曲，露出隐藏在银河系悬臂中的神秘星图。此刻的林宇正在系统空间中，看着自己的意识与王教授的量子残影产生共鸣。他们的记忆在数据流中交织，1964年的核试验现场、三星堆的神秘遗迹、赵天雷家族的阴谋，所有碎片拼凑成一幅惊人的图景——人类文明的每一次科技飞跃，都伴随着某种超越时空的力量引导。而他的试卷，不过是打开这个惊天秘密的第一把钥匙。当王教授被押解上量子加密车时，他突然挣脱束缚，用头撞向车窗。玻璃碎裂的瞬间，他的身体化作无数发光的粒子，在空中组成林宇答卷上的某个公式。李战少将捡起碎片，发现玻璃裂痕中竟浮现出从未见过的星图坐标，而这个坐标，与林宇基因检测报告里隐藏的外星代码完全对应。暴雨持续了整整一夜。第二天清晨，当陈老再次翻开林宇的答卷，所有的外星符号都已消失，只留下一行用红笔写的中文：“播种者已觉醒，创世协议即将启动。”墨迹未干的字迹下，隐约可见恐龙时代的生物细胞结构，与林宇血液中的红细胞排列方式惊人相似。而在太平洋深处，某个沉寂亿万年的海底遗迹开始发出能量波动，频率与林宇的心跳完美共振。
content_en: The rainy night in Jiangnan City was filled with salty moisture, seeping into Professor Wang's study along the cracks in the window.The old-fashioned desk lamp cast a dim yellow halo on the pile of test papers, illuminating the words "anti-gravity engine feasibility report" with a strange oily sheen.Professor Wang's reading glasses slid to the tip of his nose, and the hand holding the red pen was hanging in the air - the tip of the pen was facing the abrupt correction of the formula on Lin Yu's answer sheet, and his Adam's apple rolled up and down, making a dry swallowing sound.Three days ago, when he saw the unfinished sixth-generation machine design drawings in the safe of Mr. Chen's team in the archives of the Academy of Sciences, he felt the same chill all over.The topological structure diagram on the test paper now closely matches the scrawled drafts in my memory, and even a certain parameter that was crossed out with a red pen has been cleverly transformed into a better solution.The tip of the pen suddenly exploded with ink, and the dark red ink spread across the words "Quantum Entanglement Communication Module", like a fresh wound."Impossible..." Professor Wang loosened his tie, and the cold sweat on the back of his neck soaked the collar of his shirt.Under the microscope, the nanoscale honeycomb structure in the ink dots is slowly squirming, and the error curve of Chen's team's latest plan draws a red line on the computer screen that almost overlaps.He shakily pressed the shortcut button for the secure phone, but the dial tone turned into a high-pitched beep. The tiny bug in the desk lamp paperweight burst out sparks, casting distorted shadows on the wall.Thunder exploded outside the window, and the engine cooling pipe diagram drawn by Lin Yu vaguely emerged in the rain.Professor Wang turned around suddenly, but only saw the glass washed away by the rain.When he turned around, the handwriting on the test paper began to reorganize itself. The originally neat Chinese characters turned into tadpole-shaped alien symbols, arranged on the paper to form a totem similar to the Sanxingdui bronze mask.He staggered and held on to the edge of the table, and his lower back hit the hidden compartment of the drawer. The photos of the 1964 nuclear test site hidden there slipped out - the yellowed corners of the photo paper, and the genetic markers on the baby's swaddling clothes were exactly the same as Lin Yu's test report.Suddenly, the circuits in the entire building made a zigzag sound, and the study fell into darkness.The moment the emergency lights came on, Professor Wang saw his reflection on the glass window - his pupils were flashing with the same blue light as the system data flow.His body was twitching uncontrollably, and he was scribbling crazily on the wall with a red pen in his right hand. The twisted handwriting pieced together was actually the key formula on Lin Yu's answer sheet that had been corrected by the system.At this moment, thousands of miles away at the National Security Bureau headquarters, Major General Li Zhan stared at the abnormal fluctuations in the surveillance screen.The quantum signal intensity in Professor Wang's study suddenly surged, which was completely consistent with the energy peak during Lin Yu's exam three days ago."Activate level three alert." He took off his tactical goggles, and the holographic projection of Lin Yu's test paper remained on the lens - the parameters optimized by the system were flowing on his retina at the moment, pieced together into some kind of interstellar coordinates that exceeded existing cognition.When the special forces team broke in, Professor Wang was huddled in the mess on the ground. The red pen in his hand had broken, and blood mixed with ink drew a huge ∞ symbol on the wall.He muttered something, but what he spit out was the password to Mr. Chen's safe and the quantum coordinates of the underground laboratory of Zhao Tianlei's family business.On the other side of the city, Zhao Tianlei's father stared at the surveillance system that suddenly went black. The nano-tracker implanted in the back of his neck began to heat up - the confidential data of the sixth-generation machine stored there was being formatted by some unknown force.When Mr. Chen received the news, he was checking the mirror copy of Lin Yu's answer sheet.The printer suddenly spit out bloody paper, and the writing on it was exactly the same as the graffiti on Professor Wang's wall.The old man put on explosion-proof gloves tremblingly, but found that the fingerprint lock could not be recognized - the original design diagram in the safe was undergoing quantum state collapse, turning into light spots like stardust in the sky, and finally converging into the iconic ∞ symbol on Lin Yu's answer sheet."The seventy-third sowing..." Mr. Chen's whisper was drowned in the sound of the alarm.The dark matter detector in the basement was alarming like crazy, and the waveform on the screen was exactly the same frequency as Lin Yu's brain waves.When he looked out the window, the city lights in the heavy rain suddenly arranged into the aerodynamic shape of a sixth-generation machine, and Lin Yu's test paper was slightly hot in the safe of the National Security Bureau. The "∞8" page number on the edge exuded a pale golden light, as if the seal of some ancient civilization was being lifted.In the monitoring room of Jiangnan No. 3 Middle School, the security guard on duty stared at the screen where snowflakes suddenly appeared.All the cameras pointing at Lin Yu's examination room turned into a close-up of the Sanxingdui bronze mask. In those empty pupils, data flow was rushing at the speed of light.In the private laboratory of the Zhao Tianlei family, the sunscreen raw materials with the nano-honeycomb structure began to assemble independently, forming a three-dimensional model exactly the same as the engine on Lin Yu's answer sheet. The starry sky projection on the laboratory dome suddenly distorted, revealing the mysterious star map hidden in the cantilever of the Milky Way.At this moment, Lin Yu was in the system space, watching his consciousness resonate with Professor Wang's quantum afterimage.Their memories are intertwined in the data stream. The nuclear test site in 1964, the mysterious ruins of Sanxingdui, and the Zhao Tianlei family conspiracy, all the fragments are pieced together into an amazing picture - every technological leap in human civilization is accompanied by the guidance of some kind of power that transcends time and space.And his test paper is just the first key to unlock this shocking secret.When Professor Wang was being escorted into the quantum encryption vehicle, he suddenly broke free and banged his head against the window.The moment the glass shattered, his body turned into countless luminous particles, forming a certain formula on Lin Yu's answer sheet in the air.Major General Li Zhan picked up the fragments and found that the coordinates of a star map that he had never seen before emerged from the cracks in the glass. These coordinates exactly corresponded to the alien code hidden in Lin Yu's genetic test report.The heavy rain continued all night.Early the next morning, when Mr. Chen opened Lin Yu's answer sheet again, all the alien symbols had disappeared, leaving only a line of Chinese written in red pen: "The Sower has awakened, and the Creation Agreement is about to start." Under the still-dry ink, the biological cell structure of the dinosaur era was vaguely visible, which was surprisingly similar to the arrangement of red blood cells in Lin Yu's blood.And deep in the Pacific Ocean, a certain undersea ruins that had been silent for hundreds of millions of years began to emit energy fluctuations, and the frequency resonated perfectly with Lin Yu's heartbeat.
